title: RoadRunner Scenario Reader
text: Reads selected topic from RoadRunner scenario, 1 input, 1 output, {Topic Category} sets Topic category; {Actor Type} sets the type of actor in scenario, {Action Type} sets the type of action, {Sensor View} sets the sensor data derived from scenario ground truth Target, {Event Type} sets the type of event User-Defined, {Topic} sets the actor data, or lane boundary data captured through sensor views Actor, {Filter}, {Additional Relationship} sets the relationship to filtered entity, {Sensor ID} sets the unique index of sensor, {Sample Time} sets the sample time of simulation positive real and {Event Name} sets the name of event string. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Message
ports.summary: State information from scenario Simulink message

params.name: Topic Category
params.values: Topic category Actor (default) | Action | Sensor | Event

params.name: Actor Type
params.values: Type of actor in scenario All Types (default) | Vehicle | Traffic Signal | Traffic Signal Controller

params.name: Action Type
params.values: Type of action Path Following (default) | Change Parameter | Lane Change | Lateral Offset | Longitudinal Distance | Speed Change | User Defined

params.name: Sensor View
params.values: Sensor data derived from scenario ground truth Target Poses (default) | Target Poses For Host | Lane Boundaries | Target Poses And Lane Boundaries

params.name: Topic
params.values: Actor data, or lane boundary data captured through sensor views Actor Specifications | Actor Pose | Actor Pose (Driving Scenario compatible) | Actor Lane Location | Vehicle Specifications |...

params.name: Filter
params.values: Filter criteria Self (default) | None | Actor ID (provided by input)

params.name: Additional Relationship
params.values: Relationship to filtered entity None (default) | Parent | Children

params.name: Sensor ID
params.values: Unique index of sensor 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Sample Time
params.values: Sample time of simulation positive real scalar
